description: This PHP class 'BuzzPhotoDecorator' resides in the 'Decorator' namespace and serves as a decorator for the 'BuzzPhoto' entity. Its purpose is to provide a convenient way to access and process the 'photo' resource associated with a BuzzPhoto object, including reading the resource stream if needed.

classes.name: BuzzPhotoDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the BuzzPhoto entity that provides additional functionality for handling the photo resource.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a BuzzPhoto instance.

methods.name: getBuzzPhoto
methods.description: Protected method that returns the underlying BuzzPhoto object.

methods.name: getPhoto
methods.description: Public method that retrieves the photo. If the photo is a resource stream, it reads and converts it into a string.
